article.title: No body, no death certificate: the bureaucratic limbo trapping the widows of Gaza’s missing men
article.author: Enas Abu Ghayad
article.content: In Gaza, women whose husbands are missing or buried under the rubble are facing a little-known crisis. Without death certificates for their husbands, they're locked out of bank accounts, aid, and custody rights, trapped in bureaucratic limbo amid genocide.
